1.content: 使用 TypeScript、Bun 和 Solid 2：入门。 TypeScript 指南正文目前以英文提供，组件 API 参考包含中文说明。
1.keywords: typescript bun solid jsx ffi getting-started

2.content: Use Bun 1.4 or later, TypeScript 7, and Xcode Command Line Tools on macOS. Solid, its universal renderer, and its compiler are pinned to 2.0.0-rc.7. QuickGUI uses the Rust renderer through Bun FFI; it does not embed a webview.

3.content: 运行以下命令，并在提示时选择 TypeScript 。 In a checkout, install workspace dependencies and stage the shared library once with bun run build:native . Ordinary application edits compile TypeScript and reuse that library.

5.content: The CLI owns the process main thread and native event loop. Application code runs in a Bun worker. Production builds bundle the executable and native libraries and create an app bundle and DMG on macOS.

6.content: Explore the component reference , native services , and SwiftUI controls . The checkout includes examples/components-typescript and examples/quick-git-typescript as complete applications.

7.content: 使用 TypeScript、Bun 和 Solid 2：项目结构。 TypeScript 指南正文目前以英文提供，组件 API 参考包含中文说明。
7.keywords: typescript bun solid jsx ffi project-structure

8.hierarchy: 项目结构 › 生成的文件
8.content: The scaffold contains app.tsx , quickgui.config.ts , tsconfig.json , and package.json . Keep reusable components and application data access in ordinary TypeScript modules. Generated build files live in .quickgui and release artifacts in dist .

9.hierarchy: 项目结构 › 应用入口
9.content: Import app and Window from @quickgui/native ; import components and createRenderer from @quickgui/solid . Await app.whenReady() before opening windows. Each window owns and disposes one renderer root. The CLI starts the event consumer; application code does not call app.run() .

10.content: TOML supports the same configuration keys. Set jsx to preserve and jsxImportSource to @quickgui/solid in tsconfig.json ; the CLI applies the Solid universal transform.

11.content: Applications depend directly on @quickgui/native , @quickgui/solid , and solid-js . @quickgui/cli , TypeScript, and Bun type definitions are development dependencies. Optional terminal and updater extensions are separate packages.

12.hierarchy: 项目结构 › 本地开发
12.content: Use quickgui check for typechecking and quickgui test for application tests with the same Solid compiler and reactive client runtime as packaged builds.

13.content: 使用 TypeScript、Bun 和 Solid 2：自动更新。 TypeScript 指南正文目前以英文提供，组件 API 参考包含中文说明。
13.keywords: typescript bun solid jsx ffi updater

14.content: Install the updater extension in your application: Generate the update-signing keys, then copy the public key into your project: Keep the private quickgui-update.key outside version control. The public update-public-key.pub file belongs with your application source. Use this complete quickgui.config.ts , replacing the application metadata and download URL: The CLI embeds the public key, application version, identifier, and feed URL in the application. With this configuration, a darwin-arm64 build checks https://downloads.example.com/my-app/appcast-darwin-arm64.xml . Set updates.feedUrl to override that default; it can contain {target} . Production applications require the public-key configuration. The private key is needed when signing release artifacts with --update-manifest , and is never embedded in the application.

15.hierarchy: 自动更新 › 应用用法
15.content: Create updates.ts and import it once from your application's app.tsx . Start the updater after application readiness, outside components, so every window shares one session: The empty options object uses the settings embedded from quickgui.config.ts . A Check for Updates action can use that shared instance:

16.hierarchy: 自动更新 › 生命周期
16.content: updater.ready rejects if initialization fails. Commands return promises; handle their errors at the action that invokes them. API Use updater.check() Manually check for an update. updater.install() Install an available update from your update banner. updater.setAutomaticChecks(enabled) Change the automatic-check preference from settings. updater.state Read the last native event without polling. updater.close() Stop a session that the application no longer needs. The callback receives status, version, notes, progress, and errors. Status is idle , checking , available , downloading , installing , or disabled . Import UpdateEvent and UpdaterOptions types from @quickgui/extension-updater when needed. Closing a window must not close the shared updater. Native sessions are cleaned up when the application quits. Development builds report disabled by default. To test against a deliberately configured test feed and disposable app bundle, replace the options object with { allowDevelopment: true } . On macOS, the supplied public key must match the key embedded in the app bundle.

17.hierarchy: 自动更新 › 平台支持
17.content: The extension uses Sparkle on macOS. Windows and Linux have native implementations for signed NSIS installers and AppImages respectively; the current npm artifacts cover macOS, so other targets require extension builds on their target hosts. Linux package-manager installations report disabled . The native extension owns download verification, installation, and relaunch. The TypeScript API sends commands and receives events through the existing in-process extension bridge.

18.hierarchy: 自动更新 › 发布更新
18.content: Increase version in quickgui.config.ts for each release. Load the private signing key into the build environment: For a macOS release, use your Developer ID signing identity and configured notary profile: The CLI signs the finished update archive and writes appcast-darwin-arm64.xml . Upload the versioned archive to the directory configured by updates.baseUrl first, then upload the appcast to its feed URL. The CLI reports the artifact and appcast paths. Repeat with --target darwin-x64 for Intel Macs; each architecture uses its own feed. For CI, provide QUICKGUI_UPDATER_PRIVATE_KEY through the CI secret store and keep the public-key file in the checkout. SPARKLE_PRIVATE_KEY is also accepted. For local signing, updates.ed25519SecretKey can point to the private key file instead of using an environment variable. Set updates.manifest: true to generate a signed appcast on every production build, or updates.notesFile to include a release-notes text file. The private key must match updates.publicKey . Missing keys, mismatched keys, and unsupported update payloads fail the release build.

19.hierarchy: 自动更新 › 原生产物
19.content: In a source checkout, build the extension once. Packaged applications include its shared library, Sparkle resources or portable handoff helper, and the update metadata selected by the CLI.

20.content: 使用 TypeScript、Bun 和 Solid 2：编写扩展。 TypeScript 指南正文目前以英文提供，组件 API 参考包含中文说明。
20.keywords: typescript bun solid jsx ffi extensions

21.hierarchy: 编写扩展 › 选择扩展类型
21.content: Use an ordinary TypeScript package for reusable Solid components. Use a native extension when a feature needs a Rust, Go, or Zig service or an optional native renderer backend. All native extensions load into the same process.

22.hierarchy: 编写扩展 › 创建扩展项目
22.content: Extension scaffolds use the shared extension ABI. A TypeScript consumer can use the same extension package as Go.

23.hierarchy: 编写扩展 › 共享组件

24.hierarchy: 编写扩展 › 组织原生扩展
24.content: A native extension ships quickgui.extension.json , a versioned shared library, and any declared resources. Its manifest identifies the service name, ABI, npm package, release version, library, and per-platform resources.

25.hierarchy: 编写扩展 › 声明依赖
25.content: Add @quickgui/extension-terminal to application dependencies. Custom extensions may be selected by a scoped package such as @acme/extension-echo , an unscoped package such as quickgui-extension-echo , or a directory containing their manifest.

26.hierarchy: 编写扩展 › 实现原生接口
26.content: Implement the bounded ServiceApi or renderer extension contract in the native extension. Copy borrowed input before returning, keep event streams scoped to their sessions, and release worker resources when the session stops.

27.hierarchy: 编写扩展 › 自动注册
27.content: The CLI resolves and bundles declared extensions. The worker registers their descriptors and exact versions through FFI before creating the application, so components use the same core renderer and native resource registry.

28.hierarchy: 编写扩展 › 构建与打包产物
28.content: App edits reuse prebuilt extension artifacts. Rebuild an extension when its native implementation changes, then rebuild the application to stage those bytes. Extension resources are copied before signing.

29.hierarchy: 编写扩展 › 测试与分发
29.content: Test against a packed extension and CLI in a fresh project. Extension commands are asynchronous and share the bounded native event transport.

30.content: 使用 TypeScript、Bun 和 Solid 2：窗口与原生服务。 TypeScript 指南正文目前以英文提供，组件 API 参考包含中文说明。
30.keywords: typescript bun solid jsx ffi native-services

31.hierarchy: 窗口与原生服务 › 窗口生命周期
31.content: Create a Window with renderer: createRenderer(...) . onClose and on("closed", ...) observe native destruction; onCloseRequested can hold a user close request. close() completes it. whenReady() resolves after the native window is mounted, including hidden windows. Returned snapshots use bounds , viewportSize , and scaleFactor .

32.hierarchy: 窗口与原生服务 › 命令与服务
32.content: Native result operations return promises. Window mutations declare work immediately and are submitted after native creation. System menus and file dialogs remain native controls.

33.hierarchy: 窗口与原生服务 › 事件与文件监听
33.content: Window events include focus, resize, appearance, ready-to-show, minimize, fullscreen, and close. Application events include ready, reopen, activation, quit, open URLs, and keyboard-layout changes. Use Bun file watching and asynchronous I/O for application data; dispose watchers with their owner window. Quick Git demonstrates cancellation, bounded subprocess output, and per-window stores.

34.content: 使用 TypeScript、Bun 和 Solid 2：响应式。 TypeScript 指南正文目前以英文提供，组件 API 参考包含中文说明。
34.keywords: typescript bun solid jsx ffi reactivity

35.hierarchy: 响应式 › 响应式状态
35.content: Solid components construct once. Read signals directly in JSX to bind only the affected property or child region. A plain read in setup is a snapshot; use an accessor when the value must remain reactive.

36.content: Use createMemo for derived state shared by multiple bindings. Keep derivations pure; perform writes from events or effects.

37.hierarchy: 响应式 › 副作用与清理
37.content: Solid 2 effects separate dependency reads from their side effect. Register cleanup under the same owner so closing a window or removing a branch releases subscriptions.

38.content: Solid 2 batches ordinary signal writes automatically. QuickGUI coalesces resulting node mutations into a native batch and skips equivalent values. Use flush() in deterministic tests when assertions must observe queued render effects immediately; do not install a frame loop or polling timer for normal state updates.

39.content: 使用 TypeScript、Bun 和 Solid 2：渲染。 TypeScript 指南正文目前以英文提供，组件 API 参考包含中文说明。
39.keywords: typescript bun solid jsx ffi rendering

40.content: The Solid universal compiler creates native nodes and retained bindings. It selects the reactive client build even though Bun normally resolves server conditions. Native layout, painting, focus, input, accessibility, and component state remain in Rust.

41.content: A conditional region owns its effects and nodes. Removing the region disposes those resources; unrelated sibling nodes keep their identities.

42.hierarchy: 渲染 › 列表与节点身份
42.content: Use stable item identities for stateful rows. For moves existing nodes when order changes. Use Table or Tree for large native virtual collections and feed only requested visible data.

43.hierarchy: 渲染 › 窗口生命周期
43.content: Each Window owns an independent Solid root. Closing a child window must not dispose its siblings. Handle macOS Dock reopening by constructing a fresh window when hasVisibleWindows is false.

44.content: The current window exists during renderer construction and native event dispatch. Capture it in setup or pass it explicitly to asynchronous work.

45.hierarchy: 渲染 › 检查、测试与调试
45.content: The components gallery is the broad UI example. Quick Git exercises native menus, file dialogs, virtualized rows, splitters, shortcuts, multiple windows, background Git work, and persistence. Native integration checks are separate from headless adapter tests.

46.content: 使用 TypeScript、Bun 和 Solid 2：组件。 TypeScript 指南正文目前以英文提供，组件 API 参考包含中文说明。
46.keywords: typescript bun solid jsx ffi components

47.content: Return native JSX from ordinary TypeScript functions. Children and reactive prop getters are evaluated under the component owner; do not manually invoke components as setup side effects.

48.content: View , Text , Button , Input , TextArea , Markdown , Image , Svg , Shader , VirtualList , and optional Terminal are native building blocks. TextInput is also available as the single-line input spelling.

49.content: Compound roots coordinate their named parts through Rust-owned state. Keep parts under the intended root so their scope, focus, and value relationships are explicit.

50.content: Use controlled values with the matching change callback, or defaultValue , defaultChecked , and defaultOpen where a component supports internal state. Native events describe the core decision; update the signal to accept that value.

51.content: The reference covers selection controls, tabs, disclosure, fields, menus, context menus, pickers, dialogs, popovers, preview cards, drawers, navigation menus, ranges, splitters, progress, meters, toggles, toolbars, toasts, calendars, date/time fields, scroll areas, tables, trees, and SwiftUI controls. Run examples/components-typescript for the complete gallery.

52.hierarchy: 组件 › 设置各部件的样式
52.content: Apply style to each visual part. Parts intentionally remain unstyled so layout and colors belong to the application. State hooks such as useSliderState , useTabsState , useSelectState , useMenuItemState , and useScrollAreaState expose the current native state for custom presentation.

53.content: 使用 TypeScript、Bun 和 Solid 2：路由。 TypeScript 指南正文目前以英文提供，组件 API 参考包含中文说明。
53.keywords: typescript bun solid jsx ffi routing

54.content: Rust owns route matching, normalized locations, and bounded memory history. Solid declares routes and renders the matched component chain.

55.content: Nested routes are relative to their parent. Render <Outlet /> or the layout component’s children where the next matched route belongs. A pathless route can provide a shared layout without adding a URL segment.

56.content: The controller supports push, replace, back, forward, and relative history movement. Navigation remains in the native application; it does not require a browser history object.

57.content: useLocation() and useSearchParams() expose normalized reactive accessors. Repeated query keys are retained as arrays.

58.content: 使用 TypeScript、Bun 和 Solid 2：样式与布局。 TypeScript 指南正文目前以英文提供，组件 API 参考包含中文说明。
58.keywords: typescript bun solid jsx ffi styling

59.hierarchy: 样式与布局 › 样式方法
59.content: Use kebab-case native style attributes or a style object with camelCase fields. Numeric lengths are logical pixels; supported percentages and keywords are parsed by Rust. color and textColor declare inherited text color. Rust's 272 fixed layout and style presets are available as boolean attributes and style fields: Preset helpers are boolean attributes: rounded-lg , flex-col , items-center , p-3 , text-lg , and font-bold . rounded-lg uses Rust's 8-pixel radius; p-3 uses 12 pixels from Rust's four-pixel spacing scale. Helpers take no size or string value. For custom values, use native style attributes such as border-radius={10} , padding={14} , grid-template-columns={3} , and width="50%" . Corner radii use attributes such as border-top-left-radius={8} . position-sticky is the boolean sticky-layout helper. Helpers expand before style arrays merge. Direct helper props override the corresponding style fields; false , null , or undefined withdraws a helper and reveals the underlying style. The helper types and values are generated from Rust by scripts/generate-style-helpers.ts .

60.hierarchy: 样式与布局 › 合并样式
60.content: Nested style arrays merge left to right; later fields override earlier ones. Falsy entries are ignored. Removing a style field withdraws that declaration.

61.hierarchy: 样式与布局 › 复用样式
61.content: Use JSX.Style for reusable styles. Keep getters in JSX when their values should update reactively.

62.content: Use display , flexDirection , flexGrow , flexShrink , flexBasis , alignment, and gap. Set minWidth: 0 or minHeight: 0 on flexible scroll containers so content can shrink into the available viewport.

63.hierarchy: 样式与布局 › 网格布局
63.content: Use display: "grid" , track declarations, placement, and spans for two-dimensional layouts. Grid sizing and intrinsic measurements are native; children keep their identities when positions change.

64.hierarchy: 样式与布局 › 文本与颜色
64.content: Font family, weight, size, line height, wrapping, ellipsis, decoration, and selection use retained native text. Colors accept hex, supported CSS color strings, or packed RGBA values. Images and SVGs share the core’s bounded caches.

65.hierarchy: 样式与布局 › 交互状态

66.hierarchy: 样式与布局 › 分组与具名分组悬停
66.content: Use a named group on an ancestor and groupHover or groupActive on descendants to style coordinated states. The core resolves group membership and invalidates the affected retained subtree.

67.content: 使用 TypeScript、Bun 和 Solid 2：过渡与动画。 TypeScript 指南正文目前以英文提供，组件 API 参考包含中文说明。
67.keywords: typescript bun solid jsx ffi animations

68.hierarchy: 过渡与动画 › 悬停过渡

69.hierarchy: 过渡与动画 › 状态驱动的动画
69.content: Change a reactive style value from application state. Rust interpolates supported transitions while retaining the node and its interaction state. Do not reconstruct the component on each frame.

70.hierarchy: 过渡与动画 › 时长与帧率
70.content: Transition durations accept supported numbers or duration strings. Set easing and maxFps when needed; the frame-rate value is a ceiling while animation is active, not an idle scheduling source.

71.hierarchy: 过渡与动画 › 支持的属性
71.content: Native transitions cover the documented color, border, radius, opacity, and shadow properties. Transforms are supported as native style declarations. Consult the typed transition property union for interpolation support.

72.hierarchy: 过渡与动画 › 挂载与减少动态效果
72.content: Keep an overlay mounted during its native exit transition when its component supports that lifecycle. Respect reduceMotion on window configuration and the platform preference instead of imposing a JavaScript animation loop.

73.hierarchy: 过渡与动画 › 动态图像
73.content: Image uses native image resources, including animated GIF/WebP sources. The core owns playback deadlines, cache limits, and visibility-based suspension; loading a static image does not request idle frames.

74.content: 使用 TypeScript、Bun 和 Solid 2：表单与输入。 TypeScript 指南正文目前以英文提供，组件 API 参考包含中文说明。
74.keywords: typescript bun solid jsx ffi forms-and-input

75.hierarchy: 表单与输入 › 文本输入

76.content: Field , Fieldset , labels, descriptions, controls, and error parts declare accessible relationships and validation. Field validity, touched/dirty state, validation triggers, and debounce deadlines are coordinated by Rust.

77.content: Compose Checkbox , CheckboxGroup , RadioGroup , Radio , and Switch with their indicators and labels. Controlled state is updated through each root’s change callback; disabled/read-only state belongs to the native control.

78.hierarchy: 表单与输入 › 选择器
78.content: Select , Combobox , and Autocomplete declare options ahead of native filtering and keyboard navigation. Their state hooks expose selection, query, highlight, and chips for custom parts. Keep option values stable.

79.content: Input events carry text in event.value . Structured key, pointer, gesture, drop, component-change, and commit payloads have dedicated decoder helpers. Use declared handlers so the core knows which events must cross the FFI boundary.

80.content: 使用 TypeScript、Bun 和 Solid 2：浮层与对话框。 TypeScript 指南正文目前以英文提供，组件 API 参考包含中文说明。
80.keywords: typescript bun solid jsx ffi overlays-and-dialogs

81.content: Compose Popover.Root , trigger, portal, positioner, popup, arrow, title, description, and close parts. Rust owns placement, collisions, focus, outside interaction, and dismissal. Use controlled open or the supported default-open option.

82.content: Dialog and AlertDialog add modal semantics and coordinated title, description, backdrop, viewport, and close parts. Restore focus through the native lifecycle; do not install a second JavaScript focus trap.

83.hierarchy: 浮层与对话框 › 系统浮窗
83.content: SystemPopover owns a separate native panel anchored to a mounted node. It can cross the parent’s content bounds and is disposed with its owner. The content receives its own renderer root; an anchor must belong to an open window.

84.hierarchy: 浮层与对话框 › 原生对话框

85.content: 使用 TypeScript、Bun 和 Solid 2：SwiftUI。 TypeScript 指南正文目前以英文提供，组件 API 参考包含中文说明。
85.keywords: typescript bun solid jsx ffi swift-ui

86.content: Import native SwiftUI components from @quickgui/solid/swift-ui and wrap them in Host . These controls are AppKit/SwiftUI views composed with QuickGUI’s retained scene, not replicas drawn by JavaScript.

87.content: The adapter includes buttons, labels, toggles, sliders, steppers, progress views, gauges, text and secure fields, pickers, segmented controls, date/color pickers, and popovers. Each component’s reference lists its exact prop and event types.

89.content: Use matchContents for intrinsic native sizing, including per-axis options where supported. Keep the parent’s dimensions constrained so native measurement and GPU layout agree.

90.content: SwiftUI hosting is macOS-specific. System availability determines optional appearances and controls, including Liquid Glass. Go exposes the same core capability through its own adapter.

91.content: 使用 TypeScript、Bun 和 Solid 2：修饰器与托管。 TypeScript 指南正文目前以英文提供，组件 API 参考包含中文说明。
91.keywords: typescript bun solid jsx ffi swift-ui-hosting

92.hierarchy: 修饰器与托管 › 修饰器
92.content: Apply typed modifier factories from @quickgui/solid/swift-ui/modifiers in declaration order. They include control size, tint, disabled state, label style, button border shape, and button style.

93.hierarchy: 修饰器与托管 › Liquid Glass
93.content: The operating system draws native glass where available. Layout and hit testing remain owned by the native hosting layer.

94.hierarchy: 修饰器与托管 › 反向托管

95.hierarchy: 修饰器与托管 › SwiftUI Popover
95.content: Use Popover.Trigger with a rendered SwiftUI control and Popover.Content for the presented hierarchy. A QuickGUIHostView inside that content owns a separate ordinary QuickGUI renderer.

96.hierarchy: 修饰器与托管 › 生命周期
96.content: Native and Solid ownership must agree: an embedded renderer is disposed with its host, and a presented panel is disposed with its owner. Unmounting removes handlers and retained resources; never keep a detached host alive through a global subscription.

App edits reuse prebuilt extension artifacts. Rebuild an extension when its native implementation changes, then rebuild the application to stage those bytes. Extension resources are copied before signing.

Applications depend directly on @quickgui/native , @quickgui/solid , and solid-js . @quickgui/cli , TypeScript, and Bun type definitions are development dependencies. Optional terminal and updater extensions are separate packages.

Apply style to each visual part. Parts intentionally remain unstyled so layout and colors belong to the application. State hooks such as useSliderState , useTabsState , useSelectState , useMenuItemState , and useScrollAreaState expose the current native state for custom presentation.
Apply typed modifier factories from @quickgui/solid/swift-ui/modifiers in declaration order. They include control size, tint, disabled state, label style, button border shape, and button style.

Create a Window with renderer: createRenderer(...) . onClose and on("closed", ...) observe native destruction; onCloseRequested can hold a user close request. close() completes it. whenReady() resolves after the native window is mounted, including hidden windows. Returned snapshots use bounds , viewportSize , and scaleFactor .

Image uses native image resources, including animated GIF/WebP sources. The core owns playback deadlines, cache limits, and visibility-based suspension; loading a static image does not request idle frames.

Implement the bounded ServiceApi or renderer extension contract in the native extension. Copy borrowed input before returning, keep event streams scoped to their sessions, and release worker resources when the session stops.

Import app and Window from @quickgui/native ; import components and createRenderer from @quickgui/solid . Await app.whenReady() before opening windows. Each window owns and disposes one renderer root. The CLI starts the event consumer; application code does not call app.run() .

Import native SwiftUI components from @quickgui/solid/swift-ui and wrap them in Host . These controls are AppKit/SwiftUI views composed with QuickGUI’s retained scene, not replicas drawn by JavaScript.
In a source checkout, build the extension once. Packaged applications include its shared library, Sparkle resources or portable handoff helper, and the update metadata selected by the CLI.

Increase version in quickgui.config.ts for each release. Load the private signing key into the build environment: For a macOS release, use your Developer ID signing identity and configured notary profile: The CLI signs the finished update archive and writes appcast-darwin-arm64.xml . Upload the versioned archive to the directory configured by updates.baseUrl first, then upload the appcast to its feed URL. The CLI reports the artifact and appcast paths. Repeat with --target darwin-x64 for Intel Macs; each architecture uses its own feed. For CI, provide QUICKGUI_UPDATER_PRIVATE_KEY through the CI secret store and keep the public-key file in the checkout. SPARKLE_PRIVATE_KEY is also accepted. For local signing, updates.ed25519SecretKey can point to the private key file instead of using an environment variable. Set updates.manifest: true to generate a signed appcast on every production build, or updates.notesFile to include a release-notes text file. The private key must match updates.publicKey . Missing keys, mismatched keys, and unsupported update payloads fail the release build.

Input events carry text in event.value . Structured key, pointer, gesture, drop, component-change, and commit payloads have dedicated decoder helpers. Use declared handlers so the core knows which events must cross the FFI boundary.

The public update-public-key.pub file belongs with your application source. Use this complete quickgui.config.ts , replacing the application metadata and download URL: The CLI embeds the public key, application version, identifier, and feed URL in the application. Production applications require the public-key configuration. The private key is needed when signing release artifacts with --update-manifest , and is never embedded in the application.

Native and Solid ownership must agree: an embedded renderer is disposed with its host, and a presented panel is disposed with its owner. Unmounting removes handlers and retained resources; never keep a detached host alive through a global subscription.
Native result operations return promises. Window mutations declare work immediately and are submitted after native creation. System menus and file dialogs remain native controls.

Native transitions cover the documented color, border, radius, opacity, and shadow properties. Transforms are supported as native style declarations. Consult the typed transition property union for interpolation support.

Solid 2 batches ordinary signal writes automatically. QuickGUI coalesces resulting node mutations into a native batch and skips equivalent values. Use flush() in deterministic tests when assertions must observe queued render effects immediately; do not install a frame loop or polling timer for normal state updates.
Solid 2 effects separate dependency reads from their side effect. Register cleanup under the same owner so closing a window or removing a branch releases subscriptions.

Solid components construct once. Read signals directly in JSX to bind only the affected property or child region. A plain read in setup is a snapshot; use an accessor when the value must remain reactive.

The adapter includes buttons, labels, toggles, sliders, steppers, progress views, gauges, text and secure fields, pickers, segmented controls, date/color pickers, and popovers. Each component’s reference lists its exact prop and event types.

The CLI owns the process main thread and native event loop. Application code runs in a Bun worker. Production builds bundle the executable and native libraries and create an app bundle and DMG on macOS.

The CLI resolves and bundles declared extensions. The worker registers their descriptors and exact versions through FFI before creating the application, so components use the same core renderer and native resource registry.

The components gallery is the broad UI example. Quick Git exercises native menus, file dialogs, virtualized rows, splitters, shortcuts, multiple windows, background Git work, and persistence. Native integration checks are separate from headless adapter tests.
The controller supports push, replace, back, forward, and relative history movement. Navigation remains in the native application; it does not require a browser history object.
The current window exists during renderer construction and native event dispatch. Capture it in setup or pass it explicitly to asynchronous work.

The extension uses Sparkle on macOS. Windows and Linux have native implementations for signed NSIS installers and AppImages respectively; the current npm artifacts cover macOS, so other targets require extension builds on their target hosts. Linux package-manager installations report disabled . The native extension owns download verification, installation, and relaunch. The TypeScript API sends commands and receives events through the existing in-process extension bridge.
The operating system draws native glass where available. Layout and hit testing remain owned by the native hosting layer.

The reference covers selection controls, tabs, disclosure, fields, menus, context menus, pickers, dialogs, popovers, preview cards, drawers, navigation menus, ranges, splitters, progress, meters, toggles, toolbars, toasts, calendars, date/time fields, scroll areas, tables, trees, and SwiftUI controls. Run examples/components-typescript for the complete gallery.

The scaffold contains app.tsx , quickgui.config.ts , tsconfig.json , and package.json . Keep reusable components and application data access in ordinary TypeScript modules. Generated build files live in .quickgui and release artifacts in dist .

The Solid universal compiler creates native nodes and retained bindings. It selects the reactive client build even though Bun normally resolves server conditions. Native layout, painting, focus, input, accessibility, and component state remain in Rust.

updater.ready rejects if initialization fails. Commands return promises; handle their errors at the action that invokes them. API Use updater.check() Manually check for an update. updater.install() Install an available update from your update banner. updater.setAutomaticChecks(enabled) Change the automatic-check preference from settings. updater.state Read the last native event without polling. updater.close() Stop a session that the application no longer needs. The callback receives status, version, notes, progress, and errors. Status is idle , checking , available , downloading , installing , or disabled . Import UpdateEvent and UpdaterOptions types from @quickgui/extension-updater when needed. Closing a window must not close the shared updater. Native sessions are cleaned up when the application quits. Development builds report disabled by default. To test against a deliberately configured test feed and disposable app bundle, replace the options object with { allowDevelopment: true } . On macOS, the supplied public key must match the key embedded in the app bundle.
Use a named group on an ancestor and groupHover or groupActive on descendants to style coordinated states. The core resolves group membership and invalidates the affected retained subtree.

Use an ordinary TypeScript package for reusable Solid components. Use a native extension when a feature needs a Rust, Go, or Zig service or an optional native renderer backend. All native extensions load into the same process.

Use Bun 1.4 or later, TypeScript 7, and Xcode Command Line Tools on macOS. Solid, its universal renderer, and its compiler are pinned to 2.0.0-rc.7. QuickGUI uses the Rust renderer through Bun FFI; it does not embed a webview.

Use controlled values with the matching change callback, or defaultValue , defaultChecked , and defaultOpen where a component supports internal state. Native events describe the core decision; update the signal to accept that value.
Use createMemo for derived state shared by multiple bindings. Keep derivations pure; perform writes from events or effects.
Use display , flexDirection , flexGrow , flexShrink , flexBasis , alignment, and gap. Set minWidth: 0 or minHeight: 0 on flexible scroll containers so content can shrink into the available viewport.
Use display: "grid" , track declarations, placement, and spans for two-dimensional layouts. Grid sizing and intrinsic measurements are native; children keep their identities when positions change.
Use JSX.Style for reusable styles. Keep getters in JSX when their values should update reactively.

Use kebab-case native style attributes or a style object with camelCase fields. Numeric lengths are logical pixels; supported percentages and keywords are parsed by Rust. color and textColor declare inherited text color. Rust's 272 fixed layout and style presets are available as boolean attributes and style fields: Preset helpers are boolean attributes: rounded-lg , flex-col , items-center , p-3 , text-lg , and font-bold . rounded-lg uses Rust's 8-pixel radius; p-3 uses 12 pixels from Rust's four-pixel spacing scale. Helpers take no size or string value. For custom values, use native style attributes such as border-radius={10} , padding={14} , grid-template-columns={3} , and width="50%" . Corner radii use attributes such as border-top-left-radius={8} . position-sticky is the boolean sticky-layout helper. Helpers expand before style arrays merge. Direct helper props override the corresponding style fields; false , null , or undefined withdraws a helper and reveals the underlying style. The helper types and values are generated from Rust by scripts/generate-style-helpers.ts .
Use matchContents for intrinsic native sizing, including per-axis options where supported. Keep the parent’s dimensions constrained so native measurement and GPU layout agree.
Use Popover.Trigger with a rendered SwiftUI control and Popover.Content for the presented hierarchy. A QuickGUIHostView inside that content owns a separate ordinary QuickGUI renderer.
Use quickgui check for typechecking and quickgui test for application tests with the same Solid compiler and reactive client runtime as packaged builds.
Use stable item identities for stateful rows. For moves existing nodes when order changes. Use Table or Tree for large native virtual collections and feed only requested visible data.
useLocation() and useSearchParams() expose normalized reactive accessors. Repeated query keys are retained as arrays.

View , Text , Button , Input , TextArea , Markdown , Image , Svg , Shader , VirtualList , and optional Terminal are native building blocks. TextInput is also available as the single-line input spelling.
